extraction.head: plugins/rename-instrumentation-middleware-to-metrics-middleware

greptile.text: Summary says the PR renames InstrumentationMiddleware to MetricsMiddleware (file renamed to metrics_middleware.go) and adds a ContextualLoggerMiddleware that takes over plugin context logging. LoggerMiddleware is simplified to use FromContext(), the Logger interface gains FromContext, and the middleware chain is reordered. Confidence score is 1/5, citing compile errors from undefined endpoint constants in the new contextual logger file and a test function in metrics_middleware_test.go still using the old 'Instrumentation' name.
Style: the logger is still named "plugin.instrumentation" and should become "plugin.metrics" for consistency. Includes a suggested change to that name.
